scripts.check: tsc -b tsconfig.json && pnpm --recursive --filter "./packages/*" run codegen --check && strider-codegen generate cdp --check && strider-codegen generate bidi --check && strider-codegen generate webkit --check
scripts.test:integration: nix develop .#integration --ignore-environment --keep TERM --keep STRIDER_RECORD --command pnpm exec vitest --run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.all: pnpm check && pnpm lint && pnpm test --run && pnpm test-types && pnpm reference
scripts.reference: pnpm jsdocs && pnpm examples && pnpm index && pnpm api-reference
scripts.codegen:protocol: strider-codegen generate cdp && strider-codegen generate bidi && strider-codegen generate webkit
scripts.codegen:audit: strider-codegen audit cdp && strider-codegen audit bidi && strider-codegen audit webkit
